opennyai_summary.decision:
This criminal appeal from jail is directed against a Judgment and Order dated 31.03.2023 passed by the Court of Special Judge [POCSO], Kokrajhar in Special Case no. 03/2021.
By the Judgment and Order dated 31.03.2023, the accused-appellant is found guilty for the offences under Sections 342/376[E] of the Indian Penal Code [IPC] read with Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences [POCSO] Act, 2012.
In view of Section 42, POCSO Act, 2012, the accused-appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 6, POCSO Act, 2012 and he has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 25 [twenty five] years and to pay a fine of Rs. 20,000/-, in default of payment of fine, to undergo another rigorous imprisonment for 2 [two] years.
He has also been sentenced under Section 342, IPC with lesser sentence.
3. The appeal is admitted for hearing.
5. As steps for service of notice upon the respondent no. 2 have already been directed by the Order dated 13.10.2023, Ms. Begum, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has prayed for 4 [four] weeks'
time to obtain a report as regards service of notice upon the respondent no. 2 from the Officer In- Charge, Gossaigaon Police Station.
6.
